channel.title: MurOS News
channel.description: Release notes and announcements for MurOS, the Debian-based firewall.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.79 released
item.description: A rule can now be checked against the kernel. Every silent failure found in this port had the same shape: an item accepted by the interface, stored, listed back, and never turned into a rule. The new check walks the configuration and separates a rule that is applied, one that waits for a reload, and one that will never be applied at all. Rule counters also work on the rules of the older pages now.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.78 released
item.description: The changelog tab of the firmware page shows something at last. A Debian package carries its own changelog, so the history up to the running version is already on the box, and the repository now publishes the changelog of every package alongside it, which lets a box read what a pending update contains before applying it.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.77 released
item.description: Wireless is driven through nl80211 instead of the FreeBSD ifconfig that no longer exists. The channel list, the transmit power table and the card capabilities come from iw, the status page shows the networks in range and the associated peers again, and an open network works: hostapd owns the beacon in every case, so an access point without encryption and a station joining an open network are both started as soon as a network name is configured.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.76 released
item.description: The source NAT rules written on the current GUI page are applied at last, with a masquerade for an interface target, a fixed address or a pool for the others. Also in this round: one-to-one NAT and IPv6 prefix translation on the nftables netmap statement, multi-WAN failover between the tiers of a gateway group including the connections already open, and per source connection limits on the firewall rules.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.75 released
item.description: Multi-WAN failover between the tiers of a gateway group, including the connections already open, one-to-one NAT and IPv6 prefix translation on the nftables netmap statement, per source connection limits on the firewall rules, host discovery on a packet socket, power savings mapped to the cpufreq governors, monit driving the Debian daemon, and the netstat diagnostics rebuilt on the Linux counters.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.41 released
item.description: Refreshed branding across the web UI, captive portal and installer, plus the usual round of fixes for the Debian platform.

item.title: Installer ISO updated
item.description: A fresh offline installer image is available from the download page. It ships the current MurOS build and needs no network access to install.

item.title: Getting started with MurOS
item.description: New to MurOS? The documentation covers installation, interface assignment and your first firewall rules.
